about: Which folders under tests/ are test data, and which tests a change in each one runs (tools/test_select.py reads this; docs/09_TESTS.md). A folder not listed here runs no test: put another project's files, tool output or scratch data in tests/ freely, and add a folder here only when a test reads it. Tests are ctest names (wildcards allowed, e.g. 'font.*'), 'label:<label>' for every test with that ctest label, or '@golden' for the screenshot tests that use the changed reference image. 'files' entries win over their folder's entry.

golden.why: a reference image: the screenshot tests that use it

tools.why: image_diff, which every screenshot test compares with

gltf.why: the glTF test models: the glTF unit tests and screenshots

font.why: picture-font samples: the font tool tests
